lesson.title: How Light Helps Plants Make Food
lesson.subject: Science
lesson.objective: Explain that light provides energy plants use to make food and use evidence to distinguish a lit leaf from a covered leaf.

learner_context.common_misconception: Plants obtain their food directly from soil.
learner_context.reader_is: A Grade 7 learner who needs concrete explanations and visible contrasts.

resource_stance.page_is_spent_on: Building and checking the causal connection between light and food making.
fails_by: Saying only that plants need light without explaining its role.
Implying soil is the plant's food.
Using advanced biochemical detail outside Grade 7 scope.
